propositions: When a child ticket has a direct parent that cannot be represented in Jira (non-epic parent in epic-only project), the outbound differ suppresses the parent field but leaves the child without context
An echo-safe breadcrumb comment should be emitted naming the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, decorated with RECONCILER_MARKER and a stable identity tag to prevent re-ingestion
The breadcrumb implementation must integrate into _diff_comments by walking upward via local_parents to find the first bound ancestor, using binding_store to check for Jira keys
The breadcrumb dedup mechanism uses a stable tag (<!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb -->) to ensure append-once behavior across multiple passes, even if the nearest represented ancestor changes
Inbound safety is enforced by the RECONCILER_MARKER substring check in _diff_comments_inbound, which skips any comment containing the marker before it enters the dedup key
